conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I have a small itchy rash on my arm, it started a couple hours ago

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: A little raised, and it's red

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: Do you have any other symptoms like fever, difficulty breathing, or swelling?

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: This is likely a minor irritant reaction. Use cool compresses and over-the-counter antihistamine cream. If it spreads or you develop other symptoms, call back.

sbar_structure.situation: 27-year-old female with localized itchy red raised rash on arm, 2-hour duration
sbar_structure.assessment: Likely localized irritant or allergic reaction; patient stable, no systemic symptoms or respiratory involvement
sbar_structure.recommendation: Supportive care: avoid irritant, cool compresses, OTC antihistamine cream; monitor for spread or systemic symptoms
